_how_to_reproduce: scripts/make_reference_latents.py --dtype float32 --write, then again with --dtype bfloat16 --write, then compare the two directories.
_what: The measured cost of bf16 over a 20-step classifier-free-guided generation at 1024px, from the REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION COMPARED AGAINST ITSELF at two dtypes. There is no implementation difference in this number at all -- it is diffusers against diffusers, same weights, same pinned noise, same token ids.
_why_it_matters: It sets a floor under any tolerance that compares a bf16 run against an fp32 oracle, and the floor is far above where this repository first set it. BG-1 originally asked for 2% relative L2; the reference cannot meet that against itself. The consequence is a methodological one rather than a threshold one: the GATE must compare at the dtype the cell is scored in, or it measures the dtype instead of the implementation.
